simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פְּרָזוֹן (H6520) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: פְּרָזוֹן (pᵉrâzôwn) means magistracy , i.e. leadership (also concretely, chieftains) First listed occurrence: Judg 5 7.
